description:

How to understand human psychology? How to read people better? How to control your emotions, identify hidden intentions, understand human behaviour and recognize the patterns people repeat in relationships, friendships, business and everyday life?

In this video, Vaibhav Kadnar explains The Laws of Human Nature by Robert Greene in simple Hinglish with practical examples and relatable situations.

The Laws of Human Nature is one of Robert Greene’s most detailed books on psychology, human behaviour, emotions, ego, relationships, character, influence, jealousy, self-awareness and the unconscious patterns that affect the way people think and act.

Most people believe they understand themselves and the people around them.

But human behaviour is rarely that simple.

People say one thing and do another. They make emotional decisions and later justify them with logic. They hide insecurity behind confidence. They repeat the same relationship, friendship and business patterns without realizing it.

And sometimes, the biggest blind spots are not in other people. They are inside us.

This video breaks down some of the most important ideas from Robert Greene’s The Laws of Human Nature and explains how you can observe behaviour more carefully, understand your own reactions better and make smarter decisions about the people around you.

In this video, you will learn:

How to understand human nature

How to understand difficult people  
How to recognize manipulation  
How jealousy and envy work  
How desire affects human behaviour  
How short-term thinking affects decisions  
How to think long term  
How to make better life decisions  
How defensiveness works  
How to communicate with stubborn people  
How attitude affects your circumstances  
How negative thinking creates self-sabotage  
How unconscious beliefs influence behaviour  
How to understand darker emotions  
How to recognize psychological blind spots  
How to improve emotional intelligence  
How to understand relationships better  
How to judge people before trusting them  
How to understand people in business  
How to choose better friends and business partners  

Understanding psychology is not about becoming suspicious of everyone.

The real advantage comes from learning to notice patterns.

How does someone behave under pressure? How do they react when their ego is challenged? How do they treat people when they no longer need something from them?

And most importantly, what patterns do you repeatedly follow without noticing?

The video explores these questions through ideas from Robert Greene’s work while connecting them with relationships, friendships, business, social media, money and everyday decision making.

If you can learn to observe behaviour instead of simply believing words, you can understand people much more clearly.

And if you apply the same observation to yourself, you can become more aware of your own emotions, biases, insecurities and decision-making patterns.

This video is especially useful for students, entrepreneurs, creators, professionals and anyone interested in psychology, self-improvement, emotional intelligence, relationships and understanding people.
